_comment: Hand-written: iconic item and Minecraft biome (see BIOMES in js/config.js) per area (keyed by the area name in tools/build_countries.py OSM_ADMIN) and per parish (keyed by the OpenStreetMap name). tools/build_countries.py merges this into data/countries/MAC.json and data/countries/MAC/area-*.json.

Macau Peninsula.lore: The old city: five parishes, the Historic Centre of Macao (UNESCO) and the 338 m Macau Tower.

Taipa.lore: Rua do Cunha in Taipa Village is lined with almond cookie shops; the airport is on the east side.

Cotai.lore: Land reclaimed between Taipa and Coloane, now the Cotai Strip of resort casinos.

Coloane.lore: Green hills, beaches and Coloane Village, where Lord Stow's Bakery made the Macanese egg tart famous.

Santo António.note: The stone façade of the 17th-century Church of St. Paul, the symbol of Macau.

São Lourenço.note: A-Ma Temple at Barra, older than the city, which is said to take its name from it.

Nossa Senhora de Fátima.note: The Border Gate (Portas do Cerco) to Zhuhai, at the northern tip of the peninsula.

Nossa Senhora do Carmo.note: Macanese villas of the 1920s on Avenida da Praia, now the Taipa Houses–Museum.

Cotai Landfill Zone.note: Resort casinos on the reclaimed land between Taipa and Coloane.

São Francisco Xavier.note: The yellow chapel on the square of Coloane Village.
